name: Priscilla
overview: Priscilla, introduced in Acts 18 alongside her husband Aquila, is depicted as a committed disciple serving alongside Paul in Corinth. Together with Aquila, she worked as a tentmaker and was actively involved in teaching, exemplified when they instructed Apollos more accurately in the faith. Their partnership highlights a model of faithful service and instruction in the early church, demonstrating a Christ-centered commitment to spreading the gospel.
